event_summary: 1721年、バッハが仕事を求めてブランデンブルク辺境伯に贈った『ブランデンブルク協奏曲』6曲は、返事も演奏の記録もないまま131年間見過ごされていた。1849年に辺境伯の書庫で偶然再発見され、バッハの死からちょうど100年後に出版。今日ではバロック音楽を代表する傑作として世界中で愛されている。
hook_copy: 6曲を捧げたのに[R]返事なし[/R]、[G]放置131年[/G]の末に[G]世界的名曲[/G]へ
portrait_prompt: Illustrated cinematic portrait of Johann Sebastian Bach, bust-to-shoulder composition, painterly rendering, not photorealistic. He wears a formal dark Baroque coat with a white lace jabot and an elegant curled white periwig, typical of an 18th-century German court composer. His expression is calm, dignified, and thoughtful, with deep-set eyes and a slight furrow of concentration. Soft cinematic lighting models the contours of his face with warm highlights and gentle shadow, evoking candlelit Baroque ambiance. The background is a smooth, muted solid tone (deep warm brown or dark umber gradient) with no texture, patterns, borders, vignette, or framing elements. The illustration fills the entire canvas edge-to-edge with no margins, no dark corners, and no decorative border of any kind, so it can be seamlessly cropped into an oval frame. No text, no watermark, no signature.

middle_slides.text: 1721年、まだ宮廷楽長に過ぎなかったヨハン・ゼバスティアン・バッハは、新しい仕事を得ようとブランデンブルク辺境伯に自筆の協奏曲6曲を贈った。
middle_slides.image_prompt: Oil-painting style illustration, painterly and not photorealistic, of Johann Sebastian Bach as a young court Kapellmeister in his candlelit study at night. He sits at a wooden writing desk covered with bound manuscript pages of six concertos, carefully tying ribbon around the scores or sealing them with wax, preparing them as a formal gift. He wears a modest dark Baroque coat and a simple wig, his face full of hopeful determination. Warm candlelight flickers across quills, inkwells, and stacked sheet music, casting long shadows on the stone walls of the room. Rich chiaroscuro lighting, deep browns and golds, textured brushstrokes, no text, no other people.

middle_slides.text: だが辺境伯からは返事も謝礼もなく、楽譜は演奏されないまま131年間も書庫の奥に眠り続け、彼の遺品目録にすら名前が残らなかった。
middle_slides.image_prompt: Oil-painting style illustration, painterly and not photorealistic, showing Johann Sebastian Bach standing alone in a vast, shadowy noble library filled with towering wooden shelves. A stack of his manuscript scores lies untouched and gathering dust and faint cobwebs on a high shelf, bathed in dim, cold light filtering through a small window, suggesting the passage of many silent years. Bach stands slightly apart, gazing at the neglected scores with a quiet, melancholic expression, his figure partly in shadow to evoke obscurity and forgotten time. Muted color palette of grays, deep browns, and faded gold, thick textured brushstrokes, no text, no other people.

middle_slides.text: 1849年、辺境伯の書庫に埋もれていたこの楽譜が偶然発見され、バッハの死からちょうど100年後についに出版の日の目を見た。
middle_slides.image_prompt: Oil-painting style illustration, painterly and not photorealistic, depicting the moment of rediscovery in an old noble archive. A shaft of golden sunlight streams through a tall window, illuminating swirling dust particles above a dusty stack of manuscript scores being pulled from a forgotten shelf by an unseen hand. In the scene, a painted portrait or bust of Johann Sebastian Bach hangs faintly on the archive wall in the background, as if silently witnessing the discovery after a century of obscurity. Warm luminous light contrasts with the surrounding dim, shadowed library, rich textured brushwork, dramatic chiaroscuro, no text, no modern people.

middle_slides.text: 今やこの協奏曲集はバッハ最大の傑作の一つと称えられ、世界中のオーケストラが日々レパートリーとして競うように演奏し続けている。
middle_slides.image_prompt: Oil-painting style illustration, painterly and not photorealistic, of a grand modern concert hall filled with an orchestra passionately performing on stage under warm golden stage lighting, evoking the timeless popularity of the Brandenburg Concertos. Above or behind the stage, a large framed portrait of Johann Sebastian Bach in his Baroque wig and coat overlooks the performance from the wall, as if watching over his enduring masterpiece. The hall is filled with rich reds and golds, dramatic lighting on the musicians' string instruments and bows in motion, expressive brushstrokes conveying energy and grandeur, no text, no other identifiable modern figures in focus.

fb_caption:
ブランデンブルクのある貴族に捧げられた6つの協奏曲は、返事も謝礼もないまま131年もの間、書庫の奥で眠り続けた。今や世界中のオーケストラが競って演奏するこの名曲集こそ、仕事を求めて贈られたバッハの"売り込み作品"だった。🎻

「忙しい大人のためのクラシック音楽ノート」では、忙しい日々の合間に、
ほんの数分だけ立ち止まりたくなる、クラシック音楽の物語を発信しています。
指揮者マエストロ・ノートが案内する、作曲家たちの知られざる人生の
ドラマ——栄光の裏にあった挫折、常識をくつがえす意外な真実——を、
毎日少しずつお届けしています。

難しい知識は必要ありません。ただ、物語として楽しんでいただければ、
それだけで十分です。

くわしくはYouTubeの本編でご覧ください。https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3ZhJRZyvEc0
